# CleanBit: Disk Space Cleaner for macOS

> Sandboxed Mac App Store disk cleaner for macOS 15+. Every item explains what it is and what happens if you remove it, and nothing is deleted until you confirm.

- Official Site: https://getcleanbit.app/
- Mac App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6829159531?pt=127116872&ct=website&mt=8
- Product Demo Video (YouTube): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SQDQhvJGRfY
- Requirements: macOS 15+, App Sandbox (no root, no background helper daemon)
- Pricing: Free scanning & 2 free cleans; $4.99/mo, $19.99/yr, or $29.99 lifetime one-time purchase
- Safety Model: Recommended caches rebuild automatically (deleted permanently by default, Trash optional); Review items, project build artifacts, manual selections, and uninstalled apps always move to Trash; Info Only items (local AI models, pnpm store, Docker disk image) are never deleted.

## English Guides
- [Is Xcode DerivedData Safe to Delete? What Happens and How to Clean It](https://getcleanbit.app/guides/is-xcode-deriveddata-safe-to-delete/): Yes, Xcode DerivedData is safe to delete. Learn what lives inside DerivedData, what actually happens after removing it, and how to clean Xcode caches safely.
- [iOS DeviceSupport and Simulators Taking 40 GB? What You Can Safely Remove](https://getcleanbit.app/guides/ios-devicesupport-and-simulators-disk-space-mac/): Reclaim tens of gigabytes from Xcode iOS DeviceSupport and CoreSimulator on macOS. Includes real Mac measurements, safe xcrun simctl commands, and cleanup limits.
- [Claude Code, Cursor and Codex Eating Disk Space on Your Mac? Here's Where It Goes](https://getcleanbit.app/guides/claude-code-cursor-codex-disk-space-mac/): Find out why Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex consume gigabytes on macOS. Includes real developer Mac measurements, read-only audit commands, and safe cleanup steps.
- [How to Find and Delete Old node_modules Folders on a Mac](https://getcleanbit.app/guides/how-to-find-and-delete-old-node-modules-on-mac/): Measure how much space old node_modules folders take on macOS, remove them safely from Terminal, and avoid breaking active or pnpm projects.

## Chinese Guides
- [Mac 上怎么找出并安全清理旧的 node_modules？（实测 304 个占 66.3 GB）](https://getcleanbit.app/zh/guides/mac-delete-node-modules/): 实测一台开发用 Mac 上 304 个 node_modules 占去 66.3 GB。手把手教你用终端安全排查、识别 pnpm 硬链接陷阱，以及何时不该直接删。
